images.alt: Square group photo of a large healthcare team seated and standing together in an indoor meeting room with tall windows in the background. Several people wear matching blue uniforms, while others wear casual or business attire. A dark blue banner across the bottom of the image reads ‘International Nurses Day’. Beneath the image are the Te Kāwanatanga o Aotearoa New Zealand Government and the Ministry of Health Manatū Hauora logos.

post.text:
Today on International Nurses Day we recognise the vital role nurses play in supporting the health and wellbeing of people and whānau across Aotearoa New Zealand and acknowledge nursing students as an important part of the future workforce. 

#InternationalNursesDay #Nurses #MinistryofHealth
